order_confirmation.subject: Your order {order_number} is in
order_confirmation.heading: Thanks, {first_name}. Your order is in.
order_confirmation.intro: We've received your order and our team is getting it ready. We'll email you again with tracking details as soon as it ships.
order_confirmation.closing: Need to change something? Reply to this email within 2 hours and we'll sort it out.

order_confirmation_pdf.heading: Thanks, {first_name}. Your order is in.
order_confirmation_pdf.intro: We've received your order and our team is getting it ready. We'll email you again with tracking details as soon as it ships.
order_confirmation_pdf.closing: Need to change something? Write to us within 2 hours and we'll sort it out.

order_cancelled.subject: Your order {order_number} is cancelled
order_cancelled.heading: Your order {order_number} is cancelled.
order_cancelled.intro: We cancelled it because {reason}. Nothing will be shipped, and you don't need to do anything.
order_cancelled.closing: Questions about your refund? Reply to this email and we'll help.

back_in_stock.subject: It's back: {item_name}
back_in_stock.heading: Good news, {first_name}. It's back.
back_in_stock.intro: The piece you asked about is back in your size. We can't hold it for you, so order soon if you still want it.

order_link.subject: The link to your order {order_number}
order_link.heading: Hi {first_name}, here's the link to your order.
order_link.intro: Use the button below to see where your order is and what's in it.
order_link.closing: Didn't ask for this link? You can ignore this email.

sign_in_code.subject: Your {store_name} sign-in code
sign_in_code.heading: Your sign-in code
sign_in_code.intro: Enter this code to sign in to {store_name}.
sign_in_code.closing: Didn't ask for a code? You can ignore this email. Your account is safe.

shipped.subject: Your order {order_number} has shipped
shipped.heading: {first_name}, your order is on its way.
shipped.intro: It left our studio today. Use the tracking number below to follow it to your door.
shipped.closing: Not home on the day? The courier will try again the next working day.

out_for_delivery.subject: Your order {order_number} arrives today
out_for_delivery.heading: {first_name}, your order arrives today.
out_for_delivery.intro: It's with the courier and on the way to your door. Keep your phone close in case they call.
out_for_delivery.closing: Not home today? The courier will try again the next working day.

shipment_delayed.subject: Your order {order_number} is running late
shipment_delayed.heading: {first_name}, your order is running late.
shipment_delayed.intro: It's still on its way, but the courier needs a little more time. Here's the new date.
shipment_delayed.closing: Sorry for the wait. Questions? Reply to this email and we'll help.

delivered.subject: Your order {order_number} was delivered
delivered.heading: Delivered. Enjoy it, {first_name}.
delivered.intro: Your order reached your shipping address. We hope everything fits just right.
delivered.closing: Didn't get your parcel? Reply to this email and we'll look into it.

ready_for_pickup.subject: Your order {order_number} is ready to collect
ready_for_pickup.heading: {first_name}, your order is ready to collect.
ready_for_pickup.intro: It's packed and waiting for you at the store.
ready_for_pickup.closing: Can't make it in time? Reply to this email and we'll hold it a little longer.

refund_issued.subject: Your refund for order {order_number} is on its way
refund_issued.heading: {first_name}, your refund is on its way.
refund_issued.intro: We checked your return and sent the money back. Banks can take a few days to show it.
refund_issued.closing: Don't see it after that? Reply to this email and we'll check with the bank.

return_received.subject: We got your return request {return_number}
return_received.heading: Thanks, {first_name}. We got your return request.
return_received.intro: Here's how to send the item back. We'll refund you once it reaches us.
return_received.closing: Changed your mind? Reply to this email before the pickup and we'll cancel the return.

payment_failed.subject: Your payment for order {order_number} didn't go through
payment_failed.heading: {first_name}, your payment didn't go through.
payment_failed.intro: Your order isn't lost. We're holding it for {hold_hours} hours so you can try again, with the same method or a different one.
payment_failed.closing: If money left your account, your bank will return it within 5 to 7 working days.
